name: 4-Benzylpiperidine
summary: A dopamine releasing agent with weak serotonin releasing properties. Little evidence of human use. Potentially dangerous in overdose given MAOI + monoamine releasing properties.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 4-Benzylpiperidine acts as a monoamine releasing agent with 20- to 48-fold selectivity for releasing dopamine versus serotonin. It is most efficacious as a releaser of norepinephrine, with an EC50 of 109 nM (DA), 41.4 nM (NE), and 5,246 nM (5-HT).

uses.text: 4-Benzylpiperidine is a drug and research chemical used in scientific studies. It has been encountered as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 4-苄基哌啶（化學式：C12H17N）是一種單胺釋放劑，釋放多巴胺的選擇性是血清素的20到48倍。它可由哌啶和苯甲醛反應，再經催化氫化得到。它和三氟乙酸酐在二氯甲烷中反應，可以得到N-三氟甲醯基-4-苄基哌啶。
